## Format Notes

- Pokemon Champions VGC 2026 Reg M-C is currently led by Rillaboom at 36.64% usage. The top of the usage chart also includes Rillaboom, Sneasler, Incineroar, Kingambit, and Salamence.
- The most common two-Pokemon core is Rillaboom, and Sneasler, appearing on 159 teams (24.3% of the sampled field).
- The top three-Pokemon core is Floette-Eternal-Mega, Incineroar, and Rillaboom, which highlights one of the most repeated structures in the format.
- The current featured top team is from M_rada at 7-0.
